blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Presidential Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento on Thursday asked Congress to boost government’s funding for peacebuilding initiatives to help transition once war-torn communities into peaceful and productive zones, using funds cut from flood control projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). In a statement, Sarmiento explained that this additional funding would enable the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (Opapru) to effectively carry out and expand its ongoing programs, fulfill existing commitments under all signed peace agreements, and sustain the continued transformation of former combatants.
